title: Xiaomi 12
description: The Xiaomi 12 (cupid) Adreno 730's firmware, what each image is for, and what the checker can and cannot verify. The sizes are from the public community mirror sm8450-mainline/firmware-xiaomi-cupid; the phone's own files may differ, so the checker accepts a range rather than an exact size. Nothing here is a claim that any of this works on a phone: it has never been loaded.

files.name: gmu_gen70000.bin
files.load: the GMU's ITCM (0x00000000), DTCM (0x10004000) and its buffer memory
files.format: block table: a run of {u32 addr, u32 size, u32 type, u32 value} entries. Entries with size == 0 are descriptors carrying a length in value; entries with type == 0xefbeadde carry data. The table must consume the file exactly.
files.format_source: Linux drivers/gpu/drm/msm/adreno/a6xx_gmu.c: struct block_header and a6xx_gmu_fw_load()
files.status: structure verified against the public mirror; where each block is accepted is not fully verified

files.name: a730_sqe.fw
files.format: unverified. No public source documents it. It is word-aligned (the size is a multiple of 4) and contains the word 0xfbadc0de at offset 0x38 and an ASCII-looking tail, but nothing here should be read as a header.

files.name: a730_zap.mbn
files.role: the zap shader, authenticated by TrustZone
files.format: a Qualcomm MDT: a 32-bit little-endian ELF whose program headers describe the segments. The zap shader path needs the magic, e_phentsize == 32, and the loadable segments' span to fit the reserved region.
files.format_source: Linux drivers/soc/qcom/mdt_loader.c: mdt_header_valid(), mdt_phdr_loadable(), qcom_mdt_get_size(); drivers/gpu/drm/msm/adreno/adreno_gpu.c: zap_shader_load_mdt()
files.status: verified: ELF32, 3 program headers, one PT_LOAD at paddr 0x1000, span 0x18bc, which fits the 0x2000 region

unverified: whether the phone's own files are byte-identical to the public mirror

whether the GMU blob's 56 KB block at address 0x4000 is accepted: Linux's a6xx_gmu_fw_load() only covers ITCM 0x0..0x4000 and DTCM 0x10004000..0x10008000, plus the GMU's buffer objects, whose layout is not public
the SQE image's format, which no public source documents
whether TrustZone will accept the zap shader for this kernel
whether the GMU will start, and whether the 3D core will leave secure mode
